scope: Descriptive learning curves on already exposed development cohorts; no fitting, no best-seed selection, no new-song confirmation.

primary_gate.scope: exploratory recipe comparison; never release or fresh-song confirmation

limits: All three prefix draws retained; means/ranges are descriptive, not independent-replicate confidence intervals.
100% uses the same full model for every prefix seed and is represented once.
Forty/seventy percent refers to within-cohort artist counts rounded upward, not exact song percentages.
Original-only versus expanded changes both training quantity and cohort composition; no matched-size causal attribution.
All 1915 evaluation rows belong to exposed development data; every prediction holds out that artist from its own fit.
The original-only arm fits 964–965 songs per outer fold, not the installed model fitted on all 1206 songs.
Partial-budget curves do not select thresholds; original probability cutoff is mapped using each actual fit’s class counts.
Source proxies, incomplete genre tags, artist aliases and upstream pretraining remain limitations; no human relabeling occurred.
